CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I., Special Branch Station
REPORT
Date. Nov. 29, 1940.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY File No 2 L (c)）

Subject Arthur Read, American citizen.

Made by D.S.I. McKeown Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Reports have been received regarding the suspicious activities of one Arthur Read, American citizen. This person prior to the election of Mr. Roosevelt as President of the U.S.A. became acquainted with a British husband and wife residing in the Palace Hotel. He claimed to be an author and stated that he was the representative of the Lindbergh-Wylie group, operating from the Broadway Mansions. Read asked the British lady if she was willing to work for the group and invited her to a dinner at the Broadway Mansions. Upon arrival, she found a number of persons including some who claimed to be Americans, others who claimed to be Russian "Fascists" and a number of Japanese. Subsequent to the dinner, the lady was told by her husband to sever all connections with Read.

Prior to submitting a report on a somewhat fantastic story, enquiries were made at the American Consulate-General regarding Read where it was ascertained that Read is already under suspicion. He is the author of a book entitled "The Adventures of an American Soldier with the Chinese Forces," and claims connections with the Detroit Free Press. He left for Japan a few days ago. It is known to the American Consulate that he was connected with Japanese and Germans north of the Creek.

（批：62%）
（印：A.C. (Special Branch)）
McKeown
D.S.I.

机密

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部警署
报告
日期：1940年11月29日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别分部登记处 档案号 2 L (c)）

事由：亚瑟·里德（Arthur Read），美国公民。

呈报人：副督察长麦基翁（McKeown） 转呈人：督察克劳福德（Crawford）

已收到关于一名美国公民亚瑟·里德可疑活动的报告。此人在罗斯福先生当选美国总统之前，结识了一对居住在华懋公寓（Palace Hotel）的英国夫妇。他自称是作家，并声称自己是林德伯格-怀利集团（Lindbergh-Wylie group）的代表，该集团以百老汇大厦为活动据点。里德询问那位英国女士是否愿意为该集团工作，并邀请她到百老汇大厦共进晚餐。到达后，她发现现场有多人，包括一些自称是美国人的人、另一些自称是俄罗斯“法西斯分子”的人，以及若干日本人。晚餐之后，该女士的丈夫要求她与里德断绝一切联系。

在提交这份略显离奇的报告之前，曾向美国总领事馆查询里德的情况，经查实，里德已受到怀疑。他是一本名为《一名美国士兵在中国军队中的冒险经历》（The Adventures of an American Soldier with the Chinese Forces）的书的作者，并声称与《底特律自由新闻报》（Detroit Free Press）有联系。他于数日前前往日本。美国总领事馆知悉，他与苏州河以北的日本人和德国人有牵连。

（批：62%）
（印：A.C.（特别分部））
麦基翁
副督察长
